mainPageIntro: The Electronic Health Information (EHI) Export for myhELO allows customers in the ambulatory setting to easily export clinical or healthcare data from patient records. Examples of datasets that can be exported are allergies, encounters, lab results, procedures, etc. Customers can choose to export all or selected myhELO EHI datasets for a single patient, multiple patients, or all patients in the practices.
